bullets.text: sorting a drawer of keys that open nothing anymore. keeping all of them. one might be for a door i forgot.
overcast at okunoin. duck carries a line about being unique and one with everything. a drop on a cedar root, indistinguishable from the rest.
unique, apparently. also one with existence. both before coffee, which seems like a lot to ask.
the umbrella by the door finally got folded. no one admits to it.
